best_before.definition: The date after which the food is still safe to eat but has gone down in quality. A quality date, not a safety date.
best_before.example: The best-before date has passed, so the biscuits are only stale, not bad.

exoskeleton.definition: The hard outer shell of an insect. It protects the body but cannot stretch, so the insect must shed it to grow.
exoskeleton.example: The empty shell of the cicada is left on the tree bark.

follow_up_question.definition: A question built on what the other person just said, which shows you were listening.
follow_up_question.example: You said you moved last year — what was it like at first?

gd_revisionism.definition: Keeping the account but changing the words in it, until the meaning that was shared is gone.
gd_revisionism.example: The word was changed from late to careless, and that was revisionism.

rainy.definition: Water is falling from the clouds. There is light rain and heavy rain.
rainy.example: It is rainy, so take an umbrella.
